name: Star Master Projector Night Lamp | 360° Rotating LED Moon & Starry Sky Projector | USB & Battery Operated | Portable Night Light | Random Color
description:
Create a relaxing and dreamy atmosphere with the Star Master Projector Night Lamp, designed to project beautiful moon and starry sky patterns onto walls and ceilings. Its 360° rotating design adds movement to the projection, making it an attractive night light for bedrooms, nurseries, children's rooms, and decorative spaces. The compact and portable design allows the lamp to be used conveniently in different settings, while its USB and battery-operated options provide flexible power choices. Whether used as a bedtime light, room decoration, or relaxing ambient lamp, it adds a charming starry effect to any space.
